name: Alex Morgan
headline: Principal Data Engineer
summary: Data platform engineer with experience defining architecture and delivering streaming and batch systems.
Led cross-team migrations and mentored engineers while improving data quality and platform reliability.
Built production pipelines using Python, SQL, Apache Kafka, and Apache Spark.

bullets.text: Defined architecture for a streaming data platform using Apache Kafka and Apache Spark, processing 40 million events daily.
Led migration of Python and SQL pipelines to AWS, reducing processing costs by 28% while maintaining recovery objectives.
Established data quality checks and observability for 120 pipelines, reducing incident investigation time from 3 hours to 45 minutes.
Mentored 6 engineers and coordinated architecture reviews across 3 product teams.
Standardized Terraform modules and deployment reviews for shared data infrastructure.
Maintained internal onboarding documentation for engineering teams.
Built Python and SQL ingestion pipelines orchestrated with Airflow, consolidating 12 source systems into a shared analytics platform.
Redesigned data modeling standards with analysts, reducing duplicated reporting logic across 8 business domains.
Implemented recovery playbooks and dataset ownership reviews to improve reliability of daily reporting.
